textSegments: Complies with ATX12 v2.4 & EPS12 v2.92
Changeable side stickers for DIY enthusiasts and gamers
Complete protections: OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, UVP, OTP

Hydro GE series, 80 Plus® Gold Power Supply, is designed to reduces operating cost and excess heat and ensure solid power delivery and long term reliability, with 135mm FDB fan arrangement for increased airflow. Hydro GE series features changeable logos that allow DIY enthusiasts to match the logo with good-looking results.
Fully Modular Design with Ribbon Cable
The modular cable design simplifies installation and neat build, in choosing only those cables you needed.
For DIY enthusiasts and gamers, Hydro GE series is the first power supply that features changeable logos, three kinds of changeable side stickers you can show your style and fit your preferences.
Stable DC to DC Output Quality

For maximum efficiency and stable voltage, Hydro GE series with DC to DC circuit design offers benefits such as better compatibility and reliablity, and high system compatibility especially in cross regulation mode.

Hydro GE series is a power supply with 80 PLUS® Gold Certification that guarantees to operate at a minimum of 90% efficiency at 50% load of PSU rated power and as a result to reduce lots of electricity cost.
Low Noise and Durable Cooling Fan
Hydro GE series is built in 135mm FDB Fan, allows for little or decreased noise level during regular operation.
Get the most reliability and greatest performance with the use of the highest quality Japan-made electrolytic capacitors for prolong lifespan.
